description: Upstream open-source sources incorporated into Uni beyond installed npm dependencies. Each entry records the exact upstream revision, integrity hash, local path, license evidence, reuse mode, modifications, and validation. Maintained per docs/opensource-reuse.md.

sources.modifications: Provenance header comment prepended; code otherwise verbatim upstream except type-level only non-null assertions on indexed accesses and regex-match destructures (required by Uni's noUncheckedIndexedAccess tsconfig). No behavioural change.
sources.notes: Pure MEMORY.md entry grammar: dated entries, until marks, superseded strikethrough, fact identity dedup, always-core safety facts. Ported as the text kernel of Uni's employee memory.

sources.notes: Topic frontmatter parsing (title/description/aliases), topic word derivation, bounded topic index rendering, and merge-preserving topic appends.

sources.upstreamPath: server/memory-journal.ts (extracted symbols: Op, editScript, splitLines, unifiedDiff, DIFF_CAP, UnifiedDiff)
sources.modifications: Extraction only: the pure LCS-based unified-diff engine lifted verbatim from the upstream file-journal module (CONTEXT inlined as 2 in the hunk-merge expression); the surrounding append-only journal is reimplemented for PostgreSQL in backend/src/modules/memory. Type-level only: three ops[cursor] indexed accesses gained non-null assertions because Uni's tsconfig enables noUncheckedIndexedAccess (upstream's does not).
sources.notes: sha256 is of the whole upstream server/memory-journal.ts; only the listed pure symbols were taken.

sources.upstreamPath: server/message-db.ts (STOP_WORDS, RECALL_FILLER, recallTerms) + server/recall.ts (RECALL_OPEN/CLOSE, recallQuery, enoughMatches, clean, renderRecall, RecallPassage/RecallResult, constants)
sources.modifications: Extraction plus one text change: the RECALL_OPEN disclosure names Uni instead of OpenMausBot. The SQLite FTS5 machinery was NOT ported — Uni matches recallTerms against PostgreSQL-stored notes in backend/src/modules/memory.
sources.notes: sha256 is of upstream server/message-db.ts; the render/query half comes from upstream server/recall.ts (sha256 1ac469c45ef648e7f743add1249dd11c1a8fad7e890a561135bac5fadaff9ff6). Recall rides in front of the turn message, never the system prompt; fence markers are neutralised so a note cannot close the block.
